question: Can a distinct pre-1578 Tongshu/almanac copy be bibliographically closed at physical-holding level after 12DI, and is that exact NLC-held 1551 copy publicly exposed in the NLC Digital Ancient Books index for direct target-table collation?
answer: YES for physical-holding identity; NO PUBLIC DIGITAL-INDEX RECORD OBSERVED for the exact copy. The National Ancient Books Census directly records 《通書類聚尅擇大全□□卷》, Ming Jiajing 30 (1551) Zhicheng movable-metal-type edition, census no. 110000-0101-0013797, call no. 14202, one fascicle, held by the National Library of China, surviving four juan (16-19). The current NLC Digital Ancient Books advanced-search index returns zero for controlled exact-title variants and zero for exact sbnumber 14202, including title/year compounds. This closes only the current public Digital Ancient Books index route; it does not prove the physical copy is undigitized, inaccessible by other NLC services, or textually lacks the Sanming/Yueling target fingerprint.
